Kara (PM): quick thread to align on launch tradeoffs for the Efficiency Adviser (batching, KV-prefix caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts). goal: pick 2 Q3 deliverables and list infra deps + acceptance criteria.
Ibrahim (Eng): agree. must call out cross-track infra: prefix-cache primitive, batching coordinator, and a safe-quant inference path. those are blockers for Platform and Enterprise slices.
Yumi (ML): concordance check is critical. propose nightly job that computes semantic-similarity and flags >2% change as WARN, >5% as CRITICAL. quant suggestions should gate on manual approval if WARN or above.
Noel (Solutions): SEs need a quick ROI calc for demos. CSV with fields: tokens_per_session, sessions_per_day, cost_per_token, est_pct_save. please add sample values for Shoply + AcmeHealth.
Kara (PM): proposed slices: Quick-Apply, Operable-Controls, and Guarded-Enterprise. quick layout below.

Quick-Apply
- Audience: self-serve devs
- Surface: Console read-only recs, single-click batching presets, ROI CSV template
- Acceptance: feature-flag, <1 extra API call when recs active, telemetry: apply-rate, uptake
- Expected impact: ~7-12% token reduction on chat apps
- Risk: noisy recommendations at first

Operable-Controls
- Audience: platform/ops teams
- Surface: batching policy DSL, KV-prefix cache rules, safe quant suggestion UI, nightly eval alerts to Console/Sentry
- Acceptance: mute/throttle per-tenant, visible eval diffs, documented SLO tradeoffs, ability to rollback a recommendation within 5 minutes
- Expected impact: ~18-32% cost reduction on batchy workloads; p95 may increase due to batching windows
- Risk: autoscaler + oncall tuning required

Guarded-Enterprise
- Audience: Dedicated/Private customers
- Surface: recommendation API, tenant canaries, signed diff reports for quant changes, auto-hold/backout on critical eval alerts, config-as-code, KMS audit compatibility
- Acceptance: security signoff, audit logs for every recommendation, SLI thresholds for auto-backout, integration tests for KMS paths
- Expected impact: 25-50% cost reduction for hot flows while preserving SLAs
- Risk: longer compliance & integration runway

Ibrahim (Eng): sample batching DSL for Operable-Controls to gauge work: ```
batch_policy:
  name: user_session_window
  grouping_key: session_id
  max_wait_ms: 50
  max_tokens: 3000
  prefer_low_latency: false
```
Yumi (ML): nightly eval pseudo: ```
orig = run_model(val_set)
quant_out = run_quant(val_set)
score = semantic_similarity(orig, quant_out) # pct
if score < 95: create_alert('quant-critical')
elif score < 98: create_alert('quant-warn')
```
Noel (Solutions): ROI template + sample numbers: Shoply -> tokens/session 600, sessions/day 10k, cost/token $0.0003, est_save 20% -> $36k/mo; AcmeHealth -> tokens/session 1200, sessions/day 2k, cost/token $0.0005, est_save 15% -> $10.8k/mo (SEs can swap numbers).
Rae (ProdDev): acceptance checklist I'll add to JIRA stories: feature-flag, <1 added API call, telemetry keys, SLI defs (batch p95), rollback plan, KMS testcases for Enterprise, security review.
Kara (PM): prioritization: Q3 pick two: Quick-Apply (fast win) and Operable-Controls (impactful). Guarded-Enterprise to Q4. objections?
Ibrahim (Eng): agree, but mark prefix-cache and safe-quant path as highest priority infra tasks. I'll spike prefix-cache this week.
Yumi (ML): I'll deliver the eval taxonomy doc + harness draft by Wed. recommend default thresholds conservative to reduce noise.
Noel (Solutions): will prepare SE one-pager + vignettes and a simple CLI script to compute ROI from CSV.
Rae (ProdDev): adding checklist and tagging security/SRE for Operable-Controls and Enterprise tracks.
infra-bot: created OPT-1401 Efficiency Adviser roadmap slice (owner: Kara).
Kara (PM): action items: Kara finalize ROI CSV + messaging (EOD Fri); Ibrahim spike prefix-cache + batch proto (PR by Tue); Yumi eval harness + taxonomy (Wed); Noel SE one-pager + sample scripts (Wed); Rae add acceptance checklist, tag security (today). locking Q3 slice Friday unless blockers. :thumbsup:
